ending.meaning: The six reviewed expansion episodes are complete or honestly bounded; this candidate defines no cumulative score gate and no later content promise.

composition_policy.candidate_entry_contract: A future release may enter here only after TASK-046 maps an accepted campaign-one ending to this label.

episodes.title: The Fourth Pair
episodes.learning_objective: Identify a socket-location fault without condemning known-good processors or memory.
prerequisite_practice: Campaign Shift 1: a public symptom starts a question but does not name the fault.
Campaign Shift 3: compare locations and keep otherwise known-good parts separate from the failing path.

public_setup.summary: A server reaches the floor after failing only when its full processor population is installed; the intake record does not establish whether a processor, memory path, socket location, or board path is responsible.

episodes.candidate_discrimination: Use configuration comparison and location-specific physical evidence to separate the socket path from processor, memory, and whole-board Candidates.

beats.summary: Sora and Malik frame the population-dependent no-POST report as a location question, not a verdict on any part.
The player must support a socket-location Isolation with discriminating Evidence.
Repeat campaign-one component-versus-location reasoning under a compute configuration change.
Choose whether the brief leads with location context or controlled comparison; both orders reconverge before Match authority begins.
Persist entry and pre-Match boundaries before the one-Ticket handoff.
Launch the ordinary generated socket-contact Ticket without exposing its hidden truth.
Receive only valid COMPLETED or ABANDONED normalization, then reconverge without lending the result to another Ticket.
Add the authoritative Match gain—two for completed closure, zero for abandonment—without testing a cumulative gate.
An interrupted active Match restarts from the pre-Match checkpoint as a fresh launch.
Carry the distinction between a failed part and a failed shared path into power-distribution segmentation.

episodes.title: Across Both Bays
episodes.learning_objective: Use cross-bay known-good comparisons to isolate a shared distribution fault.
prerequisite_practice: Campaign Shift 2: the same redundancy warning may have different actionable causes.
Expansion Shift 7: separate the suspect part from the shared path and location around it.

public_setup.summary: A server reports an out-of-range voltage and can fail to power, while the alert wording alone cannot distinguish an individual supply, its seating/input, a shared distribution path, or the system board.

episodes.candidate_discrimination: Cross-bay known-good comparisons separate individual supply and bay explanations from a fault that remains on the shared distribution path.

beats.summary: Malik presents the voltage alert and bay behavior without promoting the alert label into a diagnosis.
The player must locate persistence across supplies and bays on the shared distribution path.
Repeat campaign-one power-warning discrimination with explicit path segmentation rather than icon matching.
Persist entry and pre-Match boundaries before the one-Ticket handoff.
Launch the ordinary generated power-distribution Ticket.
Hana receives closure or an honest bounded gap, then both routes reconverge.
Add only the normalized one-Ticket Match gain and preserve the campaign-one total.
An interrupted active Match restarts from its durable pre-Match checkpoint.
Acknowledge the Shift 7 evidence-framing choice as a durable briefing habit, never as gameplay authority.
Move from fault location under failure to a warning that is actionable before outage.

episodes.title: Before the Drop
episodes.learning_objective: Treat predictive failure as actionable while protecting data and proving completed recovery.
prerequisite_practice: Campaign Shift 6: each storage Ticket needs its own Isolation, Repair, independent Verify, and documented limit.
Campaign-wide practice: warnings and public context are not themselves causal truth.

public_setup.summary: An array member remains online but carries a predictive warning; the work must distinguish early media risk from an already failed member while protecting the array.

episodes.candidate_discrimination: Read current member health as evidence that can justify pre-failure action, while keeping predictive-risk and already-failed-member Candidates distinct.

beats.summary: Jonah frames a current predictive warning as a bounded risk record rather than a completed outage.
The player must act before failure while retaining the data-preservation boundary and an independent completed-rebuild Verify.
Repeat campaign-one independent storage closure with a proactive rather than already-failed member.
Persist entry and pre-Match boundaries before the one-Ticket handoff.
Launch the ordinary generated predictive-drive Ticket.
Receive a verified rebuild closure or preserve unresolved risk; reconverge afterward.
Add only the normalized result gain, with no threshold that blocks the next lesson.
An interrupted active Match is discarded and freshly launched from pre-Match.
Turn from proactive warning evidence to the harder question of whether a persistent alert describes current state at all.

episodes.title: The Alert That Stayed
episodes.learning_objective: Separate read-only evidence preservation from the state-changing Repair that clears a stale alert.
prerequisite_practice: Campaign Shift 5: preserve source, target, condition, output, and time with negative results.
Campaign Story: a historical record is context, not current machine truth.

public_setup.summary: A management alert persists even though the visible device inventory does not show a matching present failure; current state and alert chronology must remain separate until tested.

episodes.candidate_discrimination: Preserve and compare current event state against current device state before any action clears or rewrites the alert surface.

beats.summary: Hana and Jonah expose the mismatch between a persistent alert and current inventory without declaring either stale or live.
The player must preserve and compare evidence before the state-changing clear operation.
Repeat campaign-one provenance discipline on a management surface where Test and Repair can look deceptively similar.
Choose whether the brief leads with current state or change history; both orders reconverge before Match authority begins.
Persist entry and pre-Match boundaries before the one-Ticket handoff.
Launch the ordinary generated stale-alert Ticket with the read-only Test/state-changing Repair boundary intact.
Receive nonrecurrence closure or an unresolved alert record, then reconverge.
Add only authoritative one-Ticket Story points and do not infer quality from the inherited total.
An interrupted active Match restarts from pre-Match and cannot imply that alert state was preserved or cleared.
Carry current-versus-historical discipline into corroborating a firmware regression across version changes.

episodes.title: Version A, Version B
episodes.learning_objective: Use repeated version A/B behavior and hardware elimination to diagnose a firmware regression.
prerequisite_practice: Campaign Shift 4: reproduction under named conditions does not by itself establish cause.
Campaign Shift 5: physical-link evidence and configured-state evidence remain distinct until Isolation.

public_setup.summary: A network port repeatedly changes link state after a management firmware change; physical media, interface hardware, and version compatibility remain public Candidates until corroborated.

episodes.candidate_discrimination: Combine version-compatibility evidence with sustained link-counter behavior; neither observation alone is sufficient for the selected corroborated route.

beats.summary: Malik and Sora frame repeatable link behavior across a version change without treating sequence as sufficient causation.
The player must cite two corroborating observations before the firmware Isolation becomes actionable.
Repeat named-condition reproduction and physical-versus-configured discrimination in one corroborated route.
Persist entry and pre-Match boundaries before the one-Ticket handoff.
Launch the ordinary generated firmware-regression Ticket.
Receive sustained compatible behavior or preserve the unresolved version boundary, then reconverge.
Add only authoritative Match points; corroboration is required work, not a dialogue-awarded bonus.
An interrupted active Match restarts from pre-Match with no claim that a prior soak continued.
Acknowledge the Shift 10 current-state/change-history framing choice without changing evidence or outcome authority.
Escalate from compatible version restoration to a bounded controller recovery where observing recovery state must remain separate from changing firmware.

episodes.title: Recovery State
episodes.learning_objective: Bound dangerous controller recovery to approved platform methods and verify recovery separately from the flash action.
prerequisite_practice: Expansion Shift 10: read-only inspection must precede the state-changing Repair it may justify.
Campaign Shift 6: independent Verify and Documentation preserve a bounded handoff after risky work.

public_setup.summary: A management controller is nonresponsive after an interrupted firmware operation; a recoverable controller state and a version-set problem remain distinct public Candidates.

episodes.candidate_discrimination: Inspect recovery state as a Test; treat recovery transport and firmware write as the state-changing Repair; verify controller function independently afterward.

beats.summary: Sora and Jonah frame a nonresponsive BMC after interrupted firmware work without declaring recovery state or selecting a procedure.
The player must preserve the Test-versus-Repair boundary and independently verify the recovered management function.
Repeat preserve-before-change discipline, then carry the accepted result and its bounds into a documented Story handoff.
Persist entry and pre-Match boundaries before the one-Ticket handoff.
Launch the ordinary generated BMC-recovery Ticket; no transport utility is promoted into a diagnostic Command.
Hana receives an independently verified recovery or keeps the unsafe/unresolved state bounded; a following Story handoff may document only the accepted result and its limits.
Add the authoritative final one-Ticket gain without retroactively grading campaign-one totals.
An interrupted active Match returns to pre-Match and cannot claim that a flash or recovery session resumed.
End at a single current-content checkpoint with the six explanations preserved for later scripting, audit, and release work.
